site.name: Alpha and Beta Mine
overview: Alpha and Beta Mine is a named historic gold-and-silver mine in Chaffee County's Monarch Mining District, preserved on U.S. topographic mapping near Garfield.

timeline.text: Alpha and Beta was established as a named mine locality in the Monarch district and was later preserved on federal topographic mapping of the Garfield quadrangle.

moreHistory: Available mapped-place records identify Alpha and Beta as an inactive gold-and-silver mine at roughly 11,560 feet elevation. Dependable site-specific operator, production, and detailed working chronology records have not been recovered.

sourceReferences.title: Alpha and Beta Mine Topo Map in Chaffee County, Colorado
sourceReferences.note: Identifies Alpha and Beta Mine in Chaffee County, gives coordinates 38.5655526, -106.2969679, describes it as an inactive gold and silver mine, and places it on the Garfield USGS quadrangle.

sourceReferences.title: Garfield topographic map 1:24,000 scale, Colorado
sourceReferences.note: Lists Alpha and Beta Mine among named mine features on the Garfield topographic quadrangle at approximately 11,558 feet elevation.
